## `scaPCoA`
[`scaPCoA`](https://github.com/rdeek-lab/scaPCoA) is an R package for supervised and covariate-adjusted principal coordinates analysis (scaPCoA). The algorithm utilizes outcome information, while simultaneously minimizing the influence of nuisance variables, to produce supervised and covariate-adjusted low-dimensional embeddings for use in visualization and downstream regression and classification tasks.

## `CoMiCoN`
[`CoMiCoN`](https://github.com/rebeccadeek/CoMiCoN) is an R package for microbial covariation and network analysis. It uses a mixture margin copula model to model a pair of microbial relative abundances. The copula dependence parameter, $\theta$, captures the covariation for the pair of microbes and can be used to build covariation networks. The package implements a two-stage maximum likelihood estimation (tsMLE) procedure and a two-stage likelihood ratio test (tsLRT) for the CoMiCoN model.


## `zinLDA`

Zero-inflated latent Dirichlet allocation ([`zinLDA`](https://github.com/rebeccadeek/zinLDA)) is an unsupervised, hierarchical, generative probabilistic model that facilitates dimensionality reduction and detection of sparse latent clusters. This package provides implementation of a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling procedure for the zinLDA model. Additionally, it provides a method for simulating sparse count data from an underlying zinLDA model. While the original [paper](https://doi.org/10.3389/fgene.2020.602594) developed this model for applications to microbiome data and microbial subcommunity detection, it is designed to be portable to numerous types of discrete count data.
